results.title: Desktop main + packaging: external links, updater, deb/mac makers, package identity

report.summary:
Everything passed. I edited no code or tests.

1. **Targeted command:** `npx vitest run src/external-links.edge.test.ts forge.config.edge.test.ts`, run in `E:/research-clones/hypergen/apps/desktop`, exited 0. Both test files passed, 50 of 50 tests.
2. **Typecheck:** `npx tsc --noEmit` (the package's `check` script) exited 0 with no output. I checked the exit code directly, which confirms the clean typecheck the test-writer couldn't verify.
3. **Full desktop suite:** `npx vitest run` in `apps/desktop` exited 0. All 39 test files passed, 533 of 533 tests.

There were no failures, so there was nothing to compare against a baseline. I didn't find a HANDOFF file in `E:/research-clones/hypergen`; the bash call reported exit code 2 only because the `ls` looking for it found nothing.

I didn't run the repo-wide suites, since this isn't the end of the layer. The logs are in `E:/temp/claude/E--research-clones/7534b4d1-ae93-44a1-a822-daaa894f8252/scratchpad/vitest.log` and `E:/temp/claude/E--research-clones/7534b4d1-ae93-44a1-a822-daaa894f8252/scratchpad/tsc.log`.

results.title: Agent docs, tool descriptions, project template and README accuracy

report.summary:
All of subtask C's tests pass and both packages typecheck cleanly. No tests failed, so there was nothing to compare against the HANDOFF baseline.

- **Targeted tests:** passed.
  - `E:/research-clones/hypergen/packages/dapi/src/docs.accuracy.edge.test.ts` ran 154 tests and all passed.
  - `E:/research-clones/hypergen/apps/desktop/src/dapi/docs.edge.test.ts` and `E:/research-clones/hypergen/apps/desktop/src/projects.readme.edge.test.ts` ran 36 tests together and all passed.
- **Affected suites:** passed. `packages/dapi` ran 13 files and 491 tests, and `apps/desktop` ran 41 files and 569 tests. These counts match what the test-writer reported.
- **Typecheck:** passed in both packages. Running `pnpm check` (`tsc --noEmit`) failed in both with "'tsc' is not recognized", because neither package has its own copy of `tsc`. This is a setup problem in the packages, not a type error. The root compiler, `E:/research-clones/hypergen/node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`, ran with exit 0 in `packages/dapi` and in `apps/desktop`.

I did not run `apps/web` or the full suites, because this is not the end of a layer. The test-writer's own caveat still applies: the test "keeps a display name with Windows-hostile characters out of the commands table" only checks the heading and that the table has at least 18 rows.
